rules.greek: Greek isopsephy, 27 letters: stigma 6, koppa 90, sampi 900. Accents ignored; final sigma counts as sigma.
rules.hebrew: Hebrew gematria (mispar hechrechi): finals count the plain value of their letter. value_sofit500 counts the finals as 500 to 900.
rules.futhark: HOUSE RULE: runes were not used as numbers. Each rune carries its place in the Kylver row, Fehu 1 to Othala 24 (Dagaz 23, Othala 24). Latin letters are read by sound.
rules.armenian: Armenian numerals: 36 letters valued 1 to 9000, plus the later letters Օ (10000) and Ֆ (20000), valued the same way on the site calculator. The ligature և counts as ԵՒ (5 + 400).
